function.name: git
function.description: Inspect Git state or prepare a narrowly scoped repository control. status, diff, log, and propose_commit are read-only. checkpoint_create, checkpoint_restore, commit, and push change repository state and always require explicit approval before they run.

checkpoint_id.description: Short checkpoint identifier using letters, digits, dash, underscore, or dot.

message.description: Focused commit message, at most 120 characters.

paths.description: Explicit project-relative paths for a focused commit.

remote.description: Simple Git remote name; defaults to origin.

branch.description: Simple Git branch/ref; defaults to HEAD.
